info.title: Hindsight Memory Router API
info.description: The router controls Hindsight retain and recall operations. It encrypts unsafe content in quarantine for manual review. The router never has the quarantine private key.

tags.name: Memory
tags.description: Hindsight-compatible retain and recall interface. The router interprets the bank path value as a writer ID.

tags.name: Quarantine administration
tags.description: Manual review operations with separate credentials for each capability. Use the read, review, or cleanup credential for the applicable endpoint. Use the legacy admin credential only during migration.

tags.name: Human authentication
tags.description: Optional interactive OIDC login. Login is disabled unless you configure it.

post.summary: Preview or execute bulk quarantine cleanup
post.description: Cleanup uses a dry run by default. Execution must have the exact count from a previous preview. If the selection changes, the router returns 409.

200.description: Cleanup preview or execution result.

get.description: The response contains current metadata and an encrypted envelope for local decryption. The response never contains plaintext.

200.description: Encrypted item and review metadata.

post.summary: Approve the exact original quarantined object
post.description:
The caller decrypts the object locally. The caller submits the complete object without changes. The router examines the original SHA-256.

Retain approval preserves the original bank. Principal mode must have the current memory.retain grant of the original principal. Legacy mode must have the same writer bank. Register unknown legacy writers before approval. If you cannot make sure of the origin of a pending pre-upgrade retain request, submit the request again.

The router completes the review of completed writes without another write. The router permits recalled memories only while their digest stays the same.

200.description: Retain approval or recalled-memory allow decision.

403.description: The original principal no longer has memory.retain for the quarantined bank (authorization_denied).

200.description: Updated postpone count.

post.description: The operation removes an unapproved request from the current quarantine state. For a recalled memory, it invalidates the Hindsight memory. It also stores a reviewed-blocked audit state.

200.description: Request rejection or recalled-memory block decision.

post.summary: Reconcile an ambiguous review side effect
post.description:
The operation resolves an item in review_side_effect_started after an uncertain upstream commit. A timeout, network failure, or crash can cause this state. confirmed_applied completes the original review decision without another upstream side effect. confirmed_not_applied returns the item to postponed for a normal retry.

Both actions must have the expected content hash and update snapshot. Both use transactional compare-and-set. Neither action calls Hindsight.

200.description: Reconciled quarantine item state.

get.description:
The response contains metadata only. It includes review_side_effect_started items for reconciliation and review_side_effect_completed items for finalization. Checkpoints stay visible after their original TTL. The caller gets encrypted payloads one item at a time.

A principal token with a quarantine.review grant can list metadata only for the banks in its grants. Ciphertext reads and review actions must have admin tokens.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of reviewable items to skip.

parameters.name: bank_id
parameters.description: Select only items with a matching canonical bank_id. Principal callers must have a quarantine.review grant for this bank. Without this parameter, a principal sees the banks in its grants.

parameters.name: writer_id
parameters.description: Only items stored for this writer identity.

parameters.name: principal_id
parameters.description: Only items stored for this principal identity (stored in the writer identity column).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only items in this status, within the reviewable queue.

200.description: Pending and postponed items, plus recoverable review_side_effect_started and review_side_effect_completed checkpoints. The response orders these items by creation time.

get.description: Admin tokens get global counts and counts for each bank. A principal token with a quarantine.review grant gets counts only for the banks in its grants.

200.description: Current counts of items, ciphertext, and append-only events. Principal callers get counts only for the banks in their grants.

get.description: This endpoint is an exact alias of /health/ready. It checks router quarantine storage and Hindsight health. Anonymous callers get only a status field. An accepted router, application-principal, or human-session credential permits the full validated Hindsight health payload.

200.description: Router quarantine storage and Hindsight are healthy. Anonymous responses contain only the status field. Router-authenticated responses include the validated supported Hindsight health fields.

503.description: Router quarantine storage or Hindsight is unhealthy or unavailable.

4XX.description: The HTTP server rejected a malformed client request before it called the health handler.

get.description: This endpoint checks only that the router process and event loop can serve the request. It does not call router storage or Hindsight. It uses Hindsight's liveness response contract.

200.description: The router process serves requests.

4XX.description: The HTTP server rejected a malformed client request before it called the liveness handler.

get.description:
Metrics are available only when MEMORY_ROUTER_METRICS_ENABLED=true. Metrics are disabled by default. Access must have an admin read, review, or legacy credential. A principal token with a quarantine.review grant on at least one bank also permits access.

Metrics cover the complete router, including banks outside the grants. The response uses Prometheus text exposition format 0.0.4. If metrics are disabled, normal router authentication and endpoint-denial rules apply.

200.description: Prometheus metrics for this router process and quarantine repository.

401.description: Credential is missing, invalid, or not accepted for metrics access.

404.description: Metrics are disabled and router authentication succeeded.

429.description: Admin read, principal, or authentication-failure rate limit is more than its configured value.

503.description: Authentication or request-rate storage is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: List banks visible to the authenticated principal
get.description: This endpoint operates only in principal mode. The router preserves the Hindsight bank-list response format. It removes banks without bank.list.

200.description: Banks that the authenticated principal can list.

post.description: The router sends a safe request to the writer's configured Hindsight bank. It encrypts unknown writers or suspicious fields in quarantine. It does not write them to Hindsight. In principal mode, the path parameter is the target bank. The principal must have the matching grant.

200.description: Hindsight retain response, or a quarantine reference when policy blocks the request.

502.description: The Hindsight acknowledgment is invalid, unsafe, or not possible to scan. The write can be complete. Examine the write status before you retry. The response has no Retry-After header.

post.description:
The router queries only banks that the writer can read. It quarantines unknown writers and suspicious queries and returns no results. It excludes suspicious recalled results until manual review. If a queried bank is unavailable, the response sets partial and failed_banks.

In principal mode, the path parameter is the target bank. The principal must have the matching grant.

200.description: Hindsight-compatible recall response with ACL- and safety-filtered results plus supported top-level recall metadata.

get.summary: Get Hindsight API version and features
get.description: The endpoint returns a Hindsight-compatible /version response. It is available only with router authentication. The API version is the Hindsight version. Feature flags identify the capabilities that this interface supports.

200.description: Hindsight API version and facade-exposed capabilities.

502.description: Hindsight is unavailable, rejected the request, or returned an invalid or oversized response.

503.description: The router has no initialized Hindsight gateway, or a concurrent probe failed immediately without a cached result.

4XX.description: The HTTP server rejected a malformed client request before it called the version handler.

200.description: Success. Cache-Control: no-store.

404.description: Human authentication is disabled, or the route is unknown.

413.description: The request is more than 8 KiB.

429.description: The login rate, concurrency, or storage capacity limit is reached.

503.description: The identity provider, shared state, or active policy is unavailable.

RouterToken.description: Normal memory-router consumer token from MEMORY_ROUTER_TOKEN.

AdminToken.description: Bearer credential for the requested admin capability. Admin reads accept read or review credentials. Approve, reject, and postpone must have review credentials. Cleanup must have cleanup credentials. The legacy migration superuser permits all these operations.

PrincipalToken.description: Per-agent principal token from MEMORY_ROUTER_PRINCIPALS. The registry stores SHA-256 digests only.

HumanToken.description: Interactive OIDC login returns a short-lived human session that permits revocation. Bank operations must have the related configured human grant. The session excludes admin operations, metrics, bank administration, and configuration writes.

WriterId.name: writer_id
WriterId.description: Router writer identity. The policy maps this identity to one or more Hindsight banks.

Unauthorized.description: Router token is missing or invalid.

AdminUnauthorized.description: Admin token is missing or invalid.

Conflict.description: The requested review transition conflicts with current state, stored metadata, or the original digest.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The HTTP body, Hindsight request bounds, or encrypted quarantine item is more than a configured size limit.

MemoryRateLimited.description: Hindsight, quarantine, or principal request/concurrency limit is more than its configured value. Principal and Hindsight quota responses include Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before a retry of a request that the Hindsight quota limited.

PrincipalLimitUnavailable.description: PostgreSQL-backed principal rate or concurrency control is temporarily unavailable.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before a retry of the principal request.

RequestScanUnavailable.description: The request safety scanner is busy, stopped, failed, or went past its time limit. The router returns request_scan_unavailable. The router does not forward or quarantine content after an operational scanner failure.

MemoryUnavailable.description: Principal rate or concurrency control, or safety scanning, is temporarily unavailable. Request failures return request_scan_unavailable. Native recall-result or supplemental scan failures return recall_scan_unavailable without partial results. Operational scanner failures do not quarantine content.

AdminRateLimited.description: The number of admin API requests is more than the configured limit. SQLite deployments use per-process limits. PostgreSQL deployments share these limits. Separate limits apply to reads and mutations.

QuarantineCapacityExceeded.description: A quarantine capacity limit is reached. Limits apply to persistent items, writers or principals, banks, ciphertext, and global security-event identities. Security-event admission permits a maximum of 64 stored identities across replicas. At this limit, the router returns quarantine_security_event_capacity_exceeded. The router rejects the operation.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated principal does not have the necessary grant for this bank or scope.

RetainRequest.description: Retain requests allow at most 100 items and 524288 aggregate UTF-8 bytes across all string values forwarded downstream.

partial.description: True if at least one queried bank was unavailable. The results are incomplete.

failed_banks.description: Number of banks that failed during fan-out. This field is present only with partial.

UpstreamResponse.description: Acknowledgment object from the configured Hindsight version after a safety scan. The object preserves synchronous and asynchronous behavior and safe additional fields.

dedupe_key.description: Deterministic deduplication identity. Items created after the introduction of request-item deduplication have this field. Repeated submissions with the same identity update this item instead of creating a new item.

requarantine_count.description: Number of repeated submissions that updated this item through its deduplication identity.

bank_id.description:
Canonical bank for the item. For known-writer retain requests, this is the writer's write_bank snapshot. For single-bank recalls and suppressed recalled memories, this is the source bank. For security events with a path bank, this is that bank.

This field is absent for unknown-writer rows, multi-bank recall fan-outs, and security events without a bank.

total.description: Total number of reviewable items (pending, postponed, and recoverable review_side_effect_started and review_side_effect_completed checkpoints) across all pages.

key_wrap.description: DEK wrap identifier. RSA-OAEP-SHA256 is the in-process default. An HTTPS wrap sidecar uses WRAP-SIDECAR and must have the provider block.

provider.description: Wrap provider identity for non-default envelopes. The AES-GCM AAD binds this identity. Default RSA-OAEP-SHA256 envelopes do not have this block. The review tool selects the unwrap path from this block. The router never unwraps keys.

payload.description: Complete decrypted JSON payload. Submit the payload without changes for approval.

decision.description: Original review decision to confirm as applied. This field is optional. Retain requests accept only approve. Recalled memories accept only reject. These are the only actions with side effects for their respective kinds.

expected_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the quarantined content observed when the operator decided to reconcile.

expected_updated_at.description: updated_at snapshot observed when the operator decided to reconcile.

banks.description: Counts of held items for each bank. These counts include only rows with a canonical bank_id. Global totals also include unknown-writer and multi-bank rows.
Counts for each bank in the grants of a quarantine.review principal.

older_than.description: Select items created strictly before this instant. The timestamp must have seconds and an explicit timezone (Z or +/-HH:MM). Fractional seconds are supported, including sub-millisecond precision. Equivalent offsets select the same items. Invalid or out-of-range timestamps return 400.

expected_count.description: Necessary when dry_run is false. Use the count from a previous preview.
